summary: A Go-based tiling window manager for terminal sessions, designed to organize coding agents, workspaces, and persistent sessions.
usecases: Managing multiple terminal sessions for different projects within a single window.
Persisting agent workflows across machine restarts for AI-assisted development.
Tilting panes for simultaneous code, log, and agent output viewing.
ideas: Integrate with VS Code or terminal APIs for seamless IDE integration.
Add plugin system for custom agent inboxes and workflows.
Support remote SSH session management for distributed development teams.
